item.description:
# Knowledge 2.1.0
- A full-width, resizable Claude panel with read-only discussion, image/PDF attachments, and reviewable change proposals. - Related assistant edits apply together as one undo step, with checks for stale responses and reliable cancellation. - Fit to Title uses measured text, compact margins, and balanced wrapping for round shapes. - Clearer first-node instructions and a larger default document window.
**Claude setup:** download and extract `Knowledge-Claude-Setup-2.1.0.zip`, then follow its README. The assistant requires `uv` for setup and a signed-in Claude Code subscription; no API key is required. The editor works without this optional setup.
Existing saved node dimensions are preserved. Documents remain compatible with Knowledge 2.0; format-2 documents cannot be opened by Knowledge 1.x.
Requires macOS 15 or later; supports Apple silicon and Intel Macs.
